learning_outcomes.text: To understand introductory textbook material in their scientific field
To understand and reproduce specialized discourse in their scientific field
To define and classify scientific concepts
To have acquired knowledge as to how English grammar is used in academic context

syllabus_topics: Academic Grammar The Use of Tenses in Academic English
teaching_methods: Use of ICT in teaching (videos, PowerPoint presentations, educational games)
Use of ICT in communication with students via Moodle platform and email

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (multiple choice questions, short-answers, gap filling, reading comprehension exercises, writing)

assessment_rules: Evaluation criteria include knowledge of the taught terminology, acquisition of basic skills in academic writing, and acquisition of academic grammar. The written assignments are optional, while the written exam is compulsory.
